title: Biology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: BRANDYWINE (Pattern A, added for the University College branch-campus pass): the live bulletin page above (the same Eberly College of Science 'Biology, B.S.' page this whole plan is built from) lists its own 'Where can I complete this program?' campus availability as Abington, Altoona, Beaver, Berks, Brandywine, Harrisburg, Lehigh Valley, Schuylkill, Scranton, University Park, and York -- one shared course list, one credit total, for all of them. Brandywine's on-site Biology, B.S. (confirmed one of Brandywine's 14 real locally-completable bachelor's degrees per brandywine.psu.edu) is this exact same curriculum, not a separate University College page (University College's own bulletin section republishes an identical 'Biology, B.S. (University College)' page with the same course list for the same campus set, rather than a distinct one) -- so no new plan file is needed, only this campus-list addition. Only the six options (Ecology, General Biology, Genetics/Dev Bio, Neuroscience, Plant Biology, Vertebrate Physiology) are campus-restricted (e.g. Neuroscience and Plant Biology are University-Park-only); this plan already models the unrestricted General Biology option, so it needs no option-level change. General Biology option, University Park, standard MATH 140 start (the bulletin also has an ALEKS/MATH-21-remedial-start variant and a MATH-22/26-start variant). Uses the CHEM 210/212/213W organic-chemistry path rather than the CHEM 202/203 alternative, matching the University Park suggested plan. The '18 credits of 400-level biology, with at least 3 from each of 6 named groups (Plant and Fungi, Evolution, Genetics and Developmental Biology, Ecology, Physiology, Practicum)' requirement is modeled as 6 slots of 3 credits each (one per group) — the bulletin's own suggested plan does the same thing, listing these generically as 'BIOL 4XX' rather than specific codes, since each group has 20-30 alternative courses. 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' (24-31 credits department-list electives) and remaining Gen Ed requirements are modeled as generic slots. 'etm' marks the courses everything else in the sequence assumes are done. Post-prereq-parser-fix repair: CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22, which was never in this plan -- and MATH 22 itself real-chains through MATH 21, MATH 4, and MATH 3, none of which were present either, leaving CHEM 110 (and everything after it: CHEM 111/112/113/210/212/213W) permanently unschedulable. Added MATH 3/MATH 4 (Semester 1) and MATH 21/MATH 22 (Semester 2) explicitly to complete the real chain. The added 12 credits pushed the plan's total to 136.5cr, 0.5cr over the old 17cr/semester x 8-term ceiling -- bumped max_credits_per_semester from 17 to 18 (still a realistic PSU courseload) to keep 4-year graduation achievable rather than dropping a real requirement. HANDBOOK CROSS-CHECK: no department-published handbook beyond the bulletin was found (science.psu.edu/bio's own 'handbook' page describes the major's six options and core courses but not per-group 400-level course lists). Wired each of the 6 named 400-level groups' 'match' regex to the live bulletin's own real, exact enumerated course list per group (confirmed identical across the 2024-25, 2025-26, and current live editions via programmatic diff of the archived bulletins -- PSU last revised these lists between the 2023-24 and 2024-25 editions, so 2022/2023's plan files use a distinct, smaller, real 2022-23/2023-24 list). Also confirmed the 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' range is 'Select 24-31 credits from department list' with no enumerated list anywhere on the bulletin page (this plan's own Supporting Course slots sum to 22.5cr, slightly under that floor -- a pre-existing credit-budget compromise, not introduced by this pass); left as a generic honest placeholder since no real course list exists to back it.
